runtimeInventory.finding: Classic, Flow, and Skill Writer retain one Socrates lifecycle while all provider execution enters through AgentRuntime.
Main model steps, text workers, and structured workers share the one public provider-neutral AgentRuntime boundary.
Goal and memory candidates are retrieved concurrently, then memory selection is deterministic and may perform one goal-aware refinement.
The selected main Socrates performs the four-way goal decision without a router agent or router tools.
Classic and Flow commit the validated answer, task, bound goal/capsule, usage, and audit effects through one atomic finalization authority.

runtimeInventory.finding: Only qualifying large current-turn tool outputs receive R handles; release piggybacks on a normal tool call and exact evidence remains durable.
One shared automatic compactor preserves a recent whole-turn suffix, never rewrites the active turn, and blocks unsafe dispatch above 170k.
Classic and Flow now resolve canonical task/message identities to their physical source rows; view navigation stores references and legacy copied rows remain only as non-authoritative rollback data.
Soul confirmation is a strict no-tool AgentInstance using the same shared runtime boundary.
The server owns one typed, bounded, privacy-safe live activity sentence; the Flow client replaces that single slot instead of deriving or stacking raw tool state.
